## History

A lady in middle age, Rogerson taught a Sunday-school class for twenty years. During a Sunday school session that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) attended alone, Rogerson was encountered by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), who later shared her impression of the service upon returning home.
